summary: Managed setup and all six repair families are implemented and deployed on Railway. Local database tests pass; earlier Rookery runs verified refresh, index rollback and reported cleanup regression. Next: Jared connects Rookery through the customer screens, fixes follow observed failures, then landing and dashboard design. Broader repair qualification remains tracked separately, not a prerequisite to this walkthrough.

owner.scope: Owns the project and decides what Pooltune may inspect or change.
owner.remaining: Customer permissions must be explicit before automatic work.

customer-db.scope: Rookery on Supabase supplies the measured staging workload.
customer-db.remaining: Live Rookery also verified the operator monitor with owned synthetic traffic. Ordinary customer workloads and additional providers remain unqualified.

model.scope: Claude interprets evidence and returns a typed proposal or no change.
model.remaining: Provider failures and incorrect decisions remain possible; Go must independently check every action.

collector.scope: The monitor collects fixed or automatically discovered app-query counters and detects sustained slowdowns.
collector.remaining: Calibrate the automatic objective and qualify broader workload signals.

scheduler.scope: Built in staging: saved jobs, an always-on consumer, retries and delayed follow-ups survive restarts.
scheduler.remaining: Customer scheduling limits and abandoned-investigation lifecycle still need work.

state.scope: PostgreSQL retains enrolled query history, investigations and checkpoints. Preview account separation and bounded history passed local database tests.
state.remaining: Qualify backup and restore, retention under production load and key rotation.

investigator.scope: Two enrolled Rookery query shapes passed ordinary-traffic plan capture and saved a Sonnet diagnosis through Railway.
investigator.remaining: Build: Expand enrolled query shapes and add evidence readers for more causes. Verify: Exercise competing causes and hosted recovery during a model call.
investigator.remainingBuild: Expand enrolled query shapes and add evidence readers for more causes.
investigator.remainingVerification: Exercise competing causes and hosted recovery during a model call.

tools.scope: Managed index, refresh, richer statistics, cleanup, function memory and scheduling paths are implemented. Local database integration tests pass. Rookery managed refresh, index rollback and plain cleanup outcomes are recorded.
tools.remaining: Observe supported repairs during the customer walkthrough; remaining family-specific live checks are tracked separately.

inspection.scope: Managed readers cover supported lookup plans, statistics and cleanup evidence, function spill and provider memory, and scheduler blocking. The new reader paths pass local database tests and are deployed.
inspection.remaining: Observe evidence from Rookery app use in the customer walkthrough. Unsupported query shapes remain outside the qualified scope.

experiments.scope: Committed statistics trials, bounded function-memory allowance with fallback, scheduling follow-ups and cleanup-setting verification are implemented. Local database recovery tests pass; managed index rollback has live Rookery evidence.
experiments.remaining: Observe real customer-flow outcomes; retain the separate live qualification gaps without blocking account connection.

index.scope: The fresh managed customer connection built a native compound index. One sampled lookup fell from16.335ms to0.053ms, but protected traffic regressed, so Pooltune removed only its created index. Earlier prepared tests retained a beneficial compound index.
index.remaining: Qualify retained benefit and interruption on the new managed route, plus wider supported query shapes.
index.remainingBuild: Keep exact target and owner checks while expanding eligible shapes.
index.remainingVerification: Verify retained benefit on a new managed connection and interruption during its repair.

refresh.scope: A normally connected Rookery project selected refresh statistics without query IDs or fixture worker variables. Railway job318 verified a sampled lookup from14.503ms to0.252ms and protected completed-query means within the limits.

richer.scope: Managed column-target and joint-statistics trials, protected-traffic checks and conditional recovery pass local database tests and are deployed.
richer.remaining: Observe managed live outcomes. Restoration regenerates statistics and cannot restore the identical old random sample.

cleanup.scope: Plain VACUUM has a recorded live managed outcome with protected-traffic regression. Automatic cleanup-setting changes and restart recovery pass local database tests and are deployed.
cleanup.remaining: Managed automatic-cleanup live outcome remains unverified. Completed plain VACUUM cannot be undone.

memory.scope: Managed function discovery, spill and capacity checks, capped extra memory, baseline fallback and owner-edit protection pass local database tests and independent review. The code is deployed.
memory.remaining: Exercise a supported owner-selected function in the customer flow. Live memory benefit is not yet established on this managed route.

cron.scope: Managed scheduler collection, exact job and waiting-role checks, durable follow-up and pending recovery are implemented and locally tested. The code is deployed.
cron.remaining: Real before/after periods and interruption remain unverified on this managed route. Application-wide requests and errors remain unobserved.

recovery.scope: The hosted worker inspected a recorded index after a restart and kept the original result honest. Local checks also cover an invalid index and repeated interruptions.
recovery.remaining: Qualify recovery across other repairs, during the database command itself, and under wider project lifecycle changes.

backend.scope: An owner-scoped hosted service validates the dedicated Supabase login and controls its worker and saved history.
backend.remaining: Add automated credential rotation and qualify production account and deployment operations.

dashboard.scope: The deployed dashboard contains account entry, project setup, repair permissions, pause and saved activity.
dashboard.remaining: Use the real account-to-project flow first and fix observed failures. Then refine the existing dashboard and landing theme.

studio.scope: Studio graph registration and scripted replay exist. The Studio export is not connected to live Go evidence tools.
studio.remaining: Build: Attach an authorized Go evidence bridge to developer graph sessions and correlate worker, queue, graph, action and verification events in a visible run history. Verify: Show an actual hosted run end to end, including a requested Go read and the applied/verified result. The recorded earlier viewer proof is API registration/scripted replay, not this full live view.
studio.remainingBuild: Attach an authorized Go evidence bridge to developer graph sessions and correlate worker, queue, graph, action and verification events in a visible run history.
studio.remainingVerification: Show an actual hosted run end to end, including a requested Go read and the applied/verified result. The recorded earlier viewer proof is API registration/scripted replay, not this full live view.

screen-evidence.scope: Built: check supplied measurements and skip unsupported or healthy cases.
screen-evidence.remaining: Broader diagnosis must still use fresh evidence and retain no-change outcomes.

model-recommendation.scope: Built: send plan, index checks and the supplied cause evidence together; validate the response.
model-recommendation.remaining: This card describes the original one-call path. The separate diagnostic loop is built and can request evidence; broader customer diagnosis remains.

diagnose-causes.scope: Sonnet passed 18/18 bounded replay cases. All six owned repair routes passed hosted diagnostic runs; a separate hosted probe requested missing evidence.
diagnose-causes.remaining: Sonnet also used evidence from one owner-captured lookup and two ordinary-traffic plan shapes. Broader queries and competing causes remain.

request-evidence.scope: Named Go readers and local durable evidence recovery are built. A separate Railway/Rookery test had real Sonnet request fresh ANALYZE evidence before choosing a repair; no repair executed in that probe.
request-evidence.remaining: Requested hosted evidence for the remaining families and hosted mid-model checkpoint recovery remain unqualified.

repair-coverage.scope: All six managed repair families are implemented in the deployed build. Automated tests cover permissions, guarded execution and recovery; prior Rookery proofs retain their original scope.
repair-coverage.remaining: Customer walkthrough first. Broader live retention and interruption checks remain open and are not prerequisites to starting the walkthrough.

connect-project.scope: The deployed customer setup creates the monitor and managed Go worker. Earlier Rookery setup required no separate worker deployment or query IDs.
connect-project.remaining: Jared now connects through the customer screens. The current form requires project reference, project token, root certificate and a database password for repairs.

credential-lifecycle.scope: Managed database credentials are encrypted on Railway. Jared approved retaining one project-scoped Database Write and Logs Read token, with a non-expiring Rookery token for repeated qualification. Local tests verify encrypted owner-bound token replacement.
credential-lifecycle.remaining: Verify the retained token and disconnect cleanup through the deployed customer flow. Disconnect removes Pooltune copies but does not revoke the provider token or underlying database password.
credential-lifecycle.remainingBuild: Add managed credential and encryption-key rotation.
credential-lifecycle.remainingVerification: Verify retained monitoring access and disconnect in the customer flow; wider state-store and worker failure checks remain separate.

auth.scope: Google signup completed through real consent on Railway and retained its session on reload. Existing password login also worked after deployment. Sign-in, explicit linking, migration and security cases pass automated tests.
auth.remaining: Live returning Google sign-in and explicit linking were not repeated with Jared. Google remains in Testing with Jared registered as a test user. Public registration, password email verification and recovery remain separate gaps.

activity.scope: Railway displays the managed refresh benefit, exact index rollback and cleanup regression. New statistics reports distinguish retained improvements from restored settings with regenerated statistics.
activity.remaining: Qualify new memory and scheduling reports through Railway.

landing.scope: The existing basic landing page explains read-only Supabase monitoring and links to Create account and Sign in. Signed-in owners can open their workspace.
landing.remaining: Accounts require an invite. Public registration and recovery are tracked on Sign-in and account access.

operations.scope: Build 6c4cb22 deployed successfully to Railway as 22a116a2-be8c-42f9-a3e0-5f3d55f301b5. Local database recovery tests pass and an earlier hosted index restart is recorded.
operations.remaining: Managed mid-repair interruption, state restore and wider operational qualification remain tracked; these do not block beginning the customer walkthrough.

hosted-diagnostic-integration.scope: Connected and verified for the owned index fixture: Railway queue → diagnostic Sonnet graph → Go index repair → measured improvement. Queued job survived an actual service restart.
hosted-diagnostic-integration.remaining: The bounded single-column service-restart proof remains distinct from the newer per-repair runs. All six routes are implemented; see each connection for its verified scope. Hosted mid-model recovery remains.

diagnostic-adapter-coverage.scope: All five existing repair tools now run through the shared diagnostic investigator and guarded Go executor, with real Sonnet and owned Rookery traffic.
diagnostic-adapter-coverage.remaining: General customer collectors, requested-reader coverage across every family and broader workload qualification remain.

index-single.scope: Single-column index case verified with real Claude and ongoing traffic.
index-single.remaining: Broader query shapes and committed writes to the repaired table remain; the bounded two-column case has its own verified node.

index-compound.scope: One ordered two-column nonunique B-tree case passed real Sonnet, guarded build, before/after traffic and cleanup in Railway/Rookery. Local tests cover identity and interrupted recovery.
index-compound.remaining: Broader compound query shapes, customer grants and concurrent committed writes to the repaired table remain unqualified.

statistics-joint.scope: Railway retained joint statistics for two related columns on Rookery. The matched lookups went from 41.85 ms and 41.30 ms to 0.16 ms and 0.25 ms. Protected traffic passed.
statistics-joint.remaining: Qualify more column pairs, default planner settings and the simple setup flow.

statistics-target.scope: Railway ran and measured a higher target for one column from simple setup. The row estimate got closer while query latency rose, so PostgreSQL restored the exact previous setting and sample.
statistics-target.remaining: Qualify a representative workload where the setting delivers enough measured benefit to retain it.

cleanup-vacuum.scope: Simple setup found the query automatically. One targeted cleanup reduced 50,000 heap fetches to zero and latency from 39.96 ms to 9.28 ms.
cleanup-vacuum.remaining: Qualify other table shapes and general project privileges.

cleanup-settings.scope: Railway lowered the exact table’s trigger. PostgreSQL ran one automatic cleanup and no manual cleanup. Dead tuples dropped from 17,459 to 1,500 and the tested query from 42.93 to 23.68 ms.
cleanup-settings.remaining: Qualify shared-autovacuum load and broader table eligibility.

diagnostic-analyze.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-statistics.scope: Joint statistics: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-statistics.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-vacuum.scope: Targeted cleanup: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-vacuum.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-cron.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

index-compound-general.remaining: Qualify representative range or ordering queries, general repair authority and interrupted-action reconciliation.

enrolled-lookup-diagnosis.remaining: This card covers one integer equality lookup. The ordinary-traffic plan card records two further query shapes. Broader diagnosis remains.

enrolled-lookup-evidence.scope: Real traffic counters and current index metadata passed under the exact owner grant. PostgreSQL recorded no lookup replay.
enrolled-lookup-evidence.remaining: Passive evidence for one integer equality lookup. The measured plan and ordinary-traffic plan cards show the separate verified plan paths.

hosted-enrolled-flow.scope: Two enrolled Rookery query shapes passed ordinary-traffic plan capture and saved a Sonnet diagnosis through Railway.
hosted-enrolled-flow.remaining: The private operator worker is in standby after fixture cleanup. The dashboard has a separate verified owner flow. More workloads and hosted mid-model recovery remain.

enrolled-measured-plan.scope: One approved Rookery lookup returned one row and filtered 99,999 in a measured sequential scan. Railway attached the plan to a saved Sonnet diagnosis.
enrolled-measured-plan.remaining: Owner-operated sample for one exact lookup. See the ordinary-traffic plan card for sampled app executions.

enrolled-traffic-plans.scope: Two enrolled Rookery query shapes passed ordinary-traffic plan capture and saved a Sonnet diagnosis through Railway.
enrolled-traffic-plans.remaining: Requires opt-in logging for a dedicated direct login on the primary. More workloads, pooled and Data API sessions and cause-specific evidence remain.

project-activity-history.scope: Project-scoped polls, query windows and diagnosis timings are visible in the owning account’s Railway dashboard and history download. Reconnect preserved the diagnosis.
project-activity-history.remaining: Qualify a full week of ordinary customer traffic and its dashboard history.

preview-account-session.scope: Google signup completed through real consent on Railway and retained its session on reload. Existing password login also worked after deployment. Sign-in, explicit linking, migration and security cases pass automated tests.
preview-account-session.remaining: Live returning Google sign-in and explicit linking were not repeated with Jared. Google remains in Testing with Jared registered as a test user. Public registration, password email verification and recovery remain separate gaps.

preview-week-pilot.scope: Connect the intended Supabase project manually and observe a full week of ordinary traffic.
preview-week-pilot.remaining: Use the dashboard to review poll gaps, query timings, sustained slowdowns and diagnosis coverage.

agent-permission-setup.remaining: Complete and qualify all managed repair choices through the same customer connection.

automatic-workload-discovery.scope: The Rookery monitor found ordinary app traffic without manual query enrollment. Railway matched the discovered slow query to the saved verified compound repair.
automatic-workload-discovery.remaining: Expand workload coverage and calibrate the default objective. Verify more provider access paths.

generalized-compound-action.scope: Sonnet and PostgreSQL verified two owned two-column pairs. A separate Railway restart recovered the exact written index without building it again.
generalized-compound-action.remaining: Qualify general project permissions, more filters and ordering, and additional interruptions before or during the PostgreSQL write.

dashboard-repair-results.scope: The dashboard displays each existing report type. A live Railway job showed the confirmed compound-index action and measurements for one input.
dashboard-repair-results.remaining: Exercise the other five families and show recovery outcomes on the same hosted dashboard.

hosted-owned-index-action.scope: A signed-in Rookery project detected ordinary slow traffic, ran real Sonnet, built the approved two-column index, and displayed measured before-and-after results on Railway.
hosted-owned-index-action.remaining: This proof used one manually enrolled owned fixture and one measured input. Automatic setup permissions, more shapes and interrupted-action reconciliation remain.

discovered-index-evidence.scope: Local PostgreSQL bound scalar and compound lookups to their ordered keys. The Railway worker used that evidence for the automatic Rookery compound repair.
discovered-index-evidence.remaining: Extend to more query shapes and repair causes. The passive evidence reader supplies an estimate and leaves the app lookup unexecuted.

automatic-hosted-index.scope: Railway used the simple index checkbox and a Rookery-scoped token. Ordinary Rookery traffic supplied the query identity. Pooltune built the approved compound index and recorded the measured improvement.
automatic-hosted-index.remaining: This green card covers the owned two-key fixture and one measured input. General repair authority, more shapes and hosted restart recovery remain.

owned-index-recovery.scope: Railway restarted after PostgreSQL built the index and before performance verification. Attempt two inspected and reported the same index. PostgreSQL recorded one completed build.
owned-index-recovery.remaining: This test stops the worker between the database write and performance verification. Extend hosted reconciliation to the other repair families.

colorMeaning: Green means the stated scope has evidence, not universal production readiness. Yellow can mean implemented but awaiting customer-flow verification; read the card label and remaining work. Gray means planned. The customer walkthrough proceeds now; wider repair qualification is tracked separately.
